enchantments.tooltip: Hallowed: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Hallowed items provide an +10 Enhancement bonus to the maximum Hit Dice of undead turned.
Sacred +10: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Sacred items provide an +10 Enhancement bonus to your effective level for Turning Undead.
Sheltering +25: +25 Enhancement bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings
Fortitude Save +9: This item gives a +9 Resistance bonus to your Fortitude saves.
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
